function.name: _codestudio_create_script
function.description: Create or update a script for this AICodeStudio module (server-side access to platform data: query/insert/update/delete). The backend auto-applies the ai_{moduleId}_ prefix, injects an ownership comment, and files it under the module-named group — you only give the entity name. The same moduleId + entityName updates the existing ai_{moduleId}_{entityName}.js and returns the original scriptId; do not create entityName2 / entityName_new to bypass duplicates. One script per entity; multiple operations via multiple export functions.

entityName.description: Business entity name (ASCII, e.g. orders / students); backend forms ai_{moduleId}_{entityName}.js. Later changes for the same business entity must keep the same entityName.

content.description: Full script content. Each exported function takes (context); context.body is a string, JSON.parse it; call informat.table.* synchronously (no await); return {code:0,data:...} on success / {code:-1,error:...} on failure.

ownerAppId.description: For cross-app: pass the dashboard app's appId (the script/API is created in the source app you routed to via --appId, but its prefix/group still belongs to the dashboard module). Do NOT pass when reading the current app's data.
